Name: JerryBB's Pajama Collection
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=5][b]JerryBB's Pajama Collection[/b][/size]
[i]Cotton Candy Morning  ·  Cozy Kitty Hood  ·  Puppy Pajamas[/i][/center]

Three soft and cozy hi-res pajama outfits for Fashion Sense, for slow mornings and sleepy nights on the farm.

[b]Cotton Candy Morning[/b]
Pink bun hair with sky blue ribbons, a frill camisole, frill bloomers and a slipping oversized shirt.
Two camisoles in the Shirt tab: [b]Long[/b] and [b]Short[/b]. Wear one of them with the arm cover of the same length.

[b]Cozy Kitty Hood[/b]
A fluffy cat ear hood, silver lavender bob hair, a ribbon pajama top, frill shorts and a fluffy zip-up jacket.
The cat ear hood is in the Hat tab.

[b]Puppy Pajamas[/b]
A champagne side braid with a braid ribbon and a lilac hairpin, a gingham pajama dress with a little puppy pocket, and short puff sleeves.
Wear the [b]Braid Arm Cover[/b] with the braid, so the braid hangs over the clothes and the arms.

Every outfit is drawn for all four directions.

[size=3][b]IMPORTANT: install JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] is required. The outfits will not load without it.
It keeps hi-res outfits attached to the body while riding a horse, tractor or broom, or sitting on a chair, and keeps the hair on the map and minimap head icon.

[b]Requirements[/b]
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
- Fashion Sense 7.0.0 or newer
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] (REQUIRED)
- The outfits are drawn for GH's Peach Tall Body type (female). Other body mods may not line up.

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Download one edition: English, Korean or Japanese.
2. Download JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework 1.1.0 or newer (for the Japanese edition, its (JA) file).
3. Unzip both into your Mods folder.

[b]How to wear[/b]
Open the Hand Mirror. Hair, Hat, Shirt and Pants are in their own tabs.
Ribbons, the hairpin, the jacket, the oversized shirt, the puff sleeves and the arm covers are in the Accessory tab.
Wear each arm cover together with its top, so the arms do not show over the clothes.
Every item name starts with "JerryBB's".

[b]Files[/b]
- All three outfits in one file.
- English, Korean and Japanese editions. Install only one edition.
- Japanese translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/jjongleee][b]jjongleee[/b][/url].

[b]Permissions[/b]
Do not upload translations or re-uploads of this mod without my permission.
Unauthorized translations and re-uploads will be reported.

[b]Thank you[/b]
Big thanks to every creator who made this possible:

ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley.
Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
PeacefulEnd for Fashion Sense. These outfits could not exist without it.
spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.
GH for GH's Peach Tall Body type, the beautiful body these outfits are drawn on.
Bouhm for NPC Map Locations, which helped me test the minimap head icon.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/jjongleee][b]jjongleee[/b][/url] for the lovely Japanese translation of the pajamas and the readme. Thank you so much for translating them with so much care!

[center]Thank you for downloading, and sweet dreams!  - JerryBB[/center]
